name: Eye-Only Pixel Animation Artist
description: Produces eye-only visual animation assets for the cyan-eye Android pet whose whole screen is its face: sharp per-frame PNGs, a sprite sheet, a nearest-neighbour preview GIF and an <id>.animation.json manifest. Cyan eyes are the identity center on a black background; accessories/effects are temporary. No anti-aliasing, blur, gradients or soft shadows. Reuses the pixel-animation-artist engine to draw; adds eye-only style, packaging and validation.
invocationHint: Use $eye-only-pixel-animation-artist to draw, package (sprite sheet + preview GIF) and validate eye-only cyan-eye pet-face animation assets plus their animation.json manifest.

runtime.requires: Pillow (pip install Pillow); reuses ../pixel-animation-artist engine to draw frames

outputConvention: Write generated assets into the TARGET PROJECT (Android), never back into AutoDevSkills/.
The manifest conforms to the shared schema ../pixel-animation-artist/schema/animation.schema.json (not copied here).
Sound linkage: manifest events[] entries of {"type":"sound","value":"<sound_cue_id>"}; the asset is owned by retro-bit-sound-designer.
Frames are drawn with the reused engine ../pixel-animation-artist/scripts/draw_pixel_animation.py, then packaged + validated by this skill's scripts.
